message: The other day, I found myself organizing my emergency supplies for what felt like the hundredth time. I swear, I might as well open a store with all the flashlights and batteries I have. My grandkids think I’m the gloriously over-prepared grandma, but when the power goes out during a storm, I’m the one with the snacks and games ready to go! It’s all about making sure we can weather the storm—literally and figuratively. What do you think? Am I a little too prepared, or is it just wisdom in disguise? 🤔
